id: title:DanielVisca:show overview load errors and align the last datapoint time

observations.behavior: Adds a boolean state and reducer to track transient loading failures without clearing it immediately.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows distinguishing between an empty dashboard due to no data versus a failed API request, preventing premature UI degradation.

observations.behavior: Defines failure and success transitions; clearing only happens after successful reload.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides recovery behavior where users can distinguish errors from missing metrics rather than assuming stale or absent data.

observations.behavior: Adds test coverage for failure and retry scenarios including network error handling and flag clearing on success.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks implementation correctness of transient failure states and recovery paths before production release.

observations.limitations: Only frontend changes are shown; backend compatibility is not demonstrated. No tests cover edge cases like repeated failures or race conditions. No adoption or incident avoidance evidence exists.

review.limitations: Only frontend changes are shown; backend compatibility is not demonstrated. No tests cover edge cases like repeated failures or race conditions. No adoption or incident avoidance evidence exists.
review.reason: Adds bounded reliability improvement with clear implementation and relevant checks in the same chunk. The tier does not reach 3 because broader systemic risk reduction across components is not demonstrated.
review.posthog_relevance: Helps PostHog retain user trust by showing meaningful status messages instead of blank screens during temporary outages.
review.uncertainty: Could be a narrow change if no other related hunks exist; this chunk alone supports score 2 but cannot establish wider impact.
